thesis: The page is a panel on the shop floor: every section is labelled in masking tape like a part waiting its turn, and as you scroll the tape peels off to show the colour the panel ends up.

signature.name: Tape & Marker
signature.summary: A torn strip of yellow masking tape with marker handwriting (STN 4 · Measure · Day 2 · You get a text) labels every section; scroll (--sw-p) peels it from the right with a curling corner to reveal a basecoat-red 'Done' strip beneath. Lays across the hero h1 and tabs each filmstrip frame, peels per station in the 9-station story, carries WHO in the claim path, hangs service cards and reviews by a corner, and ends torn off in the footer. Hook: data-sw-signature='tape-label'.

palette.family: Booth Gunmetal + Masking Tape + Basecoat Red

layoutMoves: station filmstrip under a stencil-height h1
pinned 9-station counter with a drawn door panel changing finish
cards and reviews hung by a tape corner on a gunmetal floor

motion.intro: h1 lines mask up while the hero tape strip lays left to right (600ms) and the filmstrip fades in; under 1.1s, text readable from first paint.
stories: Stations (pinned >=640px, 9*55svh+100svh): station counter 1-9 ticks, the drawn door panel changes finish, each tape peels via --sw-p to a red Done strip; stacked cards under 640px.
Services: tapes lay onto cards with 60ms stagger, once.
motion.hover: Tape lifts 2px and its curled corner grows 6 to 12px; links get a tape-yellow underline that grows scaleX from the left.
